mapper.insert: insert into user_preferences ( user_id, level, daily_goal, interface_language, bio ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), 'intermediate', 20, 'ko', null ) on conflict (user_id) do nothing

insert into user_notification_settings ( user_id, daily_reminder_enabled, new_content_enabled, review_due_enabled ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), true, true, true ) on conflict (user_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select user_id::text as user_id, level, daily_goal, interface_language, bio from user_preferences where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) limit 1
select user_id::text as user_id, daily_reminder_enabled, new_content_enabled, review_due_enabled from user_notification_settings where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) limit 1
mapper.update: update users set name = #{name}, target_language = #{targetLanguage}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{userId} as uuid)
update user_preferences set level = #{level}, daily_goal = #{dailyGoal}, interface_language = #{interfaceLanguage}, bio = #{bio}, updated_at = now() where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid)

update user_notification_settings set daily_reminder_enabled = #{dailyReminderEnabled}, new_content_enabled = #{newContentEnabled}, review_due_enabled = #{reviewDueEnabled}, updated_at = now() where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select id::text as id, name, email, role, native_language, target_language from users where id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) limit 1
